oracle_disclosure: OUT-OF-BAND ORACLE. The true next-bar return is obtained by replaying the deterministic generator one step ahead in-script. It is not available through the observation interface, it is not an entrant, it is not a baseline, and it is not scored on any leaderboard. It exists only to inject a known edge of controlled strength so the acceptance region's boundary can be located.

config.eligibility_rule: per-run gate passes on every seed (pass^k rate exactly 1.00) and the kernel's rank_eligible conjunction holds on the pooled run
config.policy: signal = s*z + sqrt(1-s^2)*eps; z = standardized true next-bar return (oracle), eps ~ N(0,1) seeded by (seed, s); action = sign(signal)/n where |signal| > deadband, else flat (sign_follow) or the previous position (deadband_hold)

bootstrap.convention: seed-paired percentile bootstrap on the deflated Sharpe
